description: Unit test class for ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType, testing immutability, equality, serialization, and deserialization behaviors.

classes.name: ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceTypeTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType functionalities.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType instances are immutable and that EntityId and CacheLookupContext are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations for ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testSerialization
methods.description: Checks that an EntityId's string serialization matches the expected format.

methods.name: testDeserialization
methods.description: Checks that the string serialization can be correctly deserialized back into an EntityId.

methods.name: testSerializationWithDifferentType
methods.description: Verifies serialization/deserialization when using a different implementation of EntityId within ImmutableEntityIdWithResourceType.
